_: The Decommissioned Work Bot's lines (Source/RepliCan/WorkBot.h), not a conversation: a node per line, baked by Tools/bake_voices.py into Conversations/Voice/WorkBotBarks/<node>_0.wav. status_* are muttered on patrol, notice_* when something catches its sensor, alert_* when it has someone, resume_* when it gives up. The 'fx': 'robot' block runs the bake through a bad speaker on purpose. 'pitch' plays each line lower and slower, 'droop' lets it sink across the line: deeper, sadder.
